The nine automatic qualifying spots have gone to world No 1 Nelly Korda along with Lauren Coughlin (world No 18), Auston Kim (22), Angel Yin (25), Jennifer Kupcho (31), Yealimi Noh (39), Andrea Lee (40), Allisen Corpuz (45) and Alison Lee (55).
